source_files: Excel Data Analysis For Dummies 5th Edition PDF
system_metadata.description: Focused v2 repair log documenting significant changes.

source_recheck_basis: Excel PDF extracted text table of contents and relevant sections
official Microsoft Support pages for current flags

significant_changes.why: Removed repeated generic warnings from technique/application/gate records.

significant_changes.change: Rebuilt Excel technique records as concrete decisions
significant_changes.why: V1 had broad or boilerplate checks; v2 records include source conditions, outputs, failure modes, and agent inspection steps.

significant_changes.change: Rebuilt Python-in-Excel records with explicit boundaries
significant_changes.why: Python-in-Excel is not treated as external Python; records separate Excel grid, Python runtime, Power Query, and external automation boundaries.
Tool choice now defaults to lowest-complexity safe choice and flags when Power Query/external Python are better.
Generic gates were replaced with specific blocking/warning conditions and Excel/Python/external checks.

significant_changes.change: Made business applications fewer and richer
significant_changes.why: Templates now use placeholders for organization-specific formulas/rules and avoid inventing company policy.
Workflows now include preconditions, safe/dangerous actions, validations, backup/rollback, and completion criteria.
Routine assistant context references canonical files instead of duplicating full records.

semantic_duplicate_resolution.method: Compared v1 ID inventory, repeated field text, source-section intent, and v2 record purpose. Merged records with same decision/problem even when wording differed.

duplicate_groups_found.theme: generic Excel quality checks repeated across techniques
duplicate_groups_found.resolution: moved to reusable risk IDs and specific technique checks

duplicate_groups_found.theme: generic Python-in-Excel error/privacy warnings repeated across records
duplicate_groups_found.resolution: moved to python-excel-risk-* records and current flags

duplicate_groups_found.theme: business application templates using same analysis steps
duplicate_groups_found.resolution: kept common workflow structure but made fields, gates, outputs, and no-invent policies application-specific

duplicate_groups_found.theme: workbook architecture patterns sharing generic structure
duplicate_groups_found.resolution: made each pattern distinct by edit zones, protected zones, failure modes, and user explanation

intentional_reuse_patterns: Common workbook lifecycle order is reused across business templates where appropriate: define period, load raw, validate, analyze, reconcile, publish.

source_gap_handling.excel_data_validation: Left as operational extension because a direct Excel-book data-validation section was not found in extracted text.
source_gap_handling.python_current_availability: Handled in current verification flags because product state changes after book publication.
